notes.title: Patch note
notes.content:
Fixed a bug prevents player from playing KoH mode with non-steam friends.
Extra attack is slightly nerfed.

notes.title: King of the Hill Mode Bug Fixing
notes.content: fixing a bug that only steam friends can download each others' deck data.

notes.title: Minor Bug fixing
notes.content: Fixed a bug that when a player beat himself in a King of the Hill challenge, the deck will not uploaded successfully.

notes.title: New PvP Game Mode: King of the Hill
notes.content:
Now players can fight each other using their latest winning deck.

There will be a "x th King of the Hill" section on the left of the Main Menu.

If you win a human vs cpu game, you get a challenge rights to the current King of the Hill.

If you challenge and win, you become the new King of the Hill.

King of the Hill Leaderboard will be reset after every balance patch.
